evidence: Carries RPC/REST/ZMQ label and fixes JSON-RPC batch request parsing machinery.
rationale: Fixes a bug where malformed non-object batch elements reuse the previous element's ID or drop errors. The PR description notes that for `[{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"getblockcount","id":"X"}, 2]` the reply produces two objects with `"id":"X"`, which can confuse clients that match replies by ID.
